name: MTC Combo v2
summary: MTC Combo v2 is a multi-strategy Expert Advisor that combines multiple trading techniques (trend following, momentum, and mean reversion signals) across different timeframes to generate composite entry signals. The EA uses a combo approach where multiple independent signal components must align before opening a position, aiming to filter out false signals and improve trade quality.
summary_zh: MTC Combo v2是一个多策略组合EA，它在不同时间周期上结合趋势跟踪、动量和均值回归等多种交易技术来生成复合入场信号。该EA采用组合方法，要求多个独立信号组件对齐后才开仓，旨在过滤虚假信号并提高交易质量。
strategy_analysis: MTC Combo v2的核心策略概念是多重确认组合交易，通过融合不同类别的技术信号来提高入场可靠性。入场条件要求多个独立信号模块同时发出同方向信号，形成共振效应后才触发交易，这大幅降低了单一指标误判的概率。出场条件结合了固定止盈止损和动态跟踪止损，在保护利润的同时给予趋势足够的运行空间。仓位管理采用基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式，可根据风险承受能力调整单笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理方面包含了最大持仓限制和连续亏损后的保护机制，但具体的马丁格尔或网格特征需要根据参数配置来判断。整体策略设计偏向保守稳健，多重过滤机制有效减少了虚假信号，但也可能在高波动行情中错过部分机会。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of MTC Combo v2 is multi-confirmation combo trading, which improves entry reliability by fusing signals from different technical categories. Entry conditions require multiple independent signal modules to emit same-direction signals simultaneously, creating a resonance effect before triggering a trade, which significantly reduces the probability of single-indicator misjudgment. Exit conditions combine fixed take-profit and stop-loss with dynamic trailing stops, protecting profits while giving trends enough room to develop. Position sizing uses an account-balance-proportional calculation method, allowing adjustment of per-trade risk exposure based on risk tolerance. Money management includes maximum position limits and protection mechanisms after consecutive losses, though the presence of Martingale or grid characteristics depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy design leans conservative and steady, with multiple filtering mechanisms effectively reducing false signals, but this may also cause missed opportunities during high-volatility market conditions.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 多信号组合确认机制大幅降低了虚假信号导致的错误交易概率
多时间周期分析提供了更全面的市场视角，避免单一周期盲区
组合策略在不同市场环境下具有更好的适应性，不依赖单一市场条件
内置的动态跟踪止损能有效锁定已有利润，防止盈利回吐
仓位和资金管理模块提供了风险控制的基础框架
pros_en: Multi-signal combo confirmation mechanism significantly reduces the probability of false-signal-induced erroneous trades
Multi-timeframe analysis provides a more comprehensive market perspective, avoiding single-timeframe blind spots
Combo strategy offers better adaptability across different market environments without relying on a single market condition
Built-in dynamic trailing stop effectively locks in existing profits and prevents profitable trades from reversing
Position and money management modules provide a foundational framework for risk control
cons: 多重信号过滤可能导致入场时机滞后，在快速行情中错过最佳入场点
组合策略的参数数量较多，优化过程容易产生过拟合问题
缺乏对市场波动率和点差的实时过滤，在不利交易条件下仍可能开仓
多重确认机制在震荡市中可能频繁产生矛盾信号导致犹豫不决
策略组合的逻辑权重分配缺乏自适应调整机制
cons_en: Multi-signal filtering may cause lagging entries, missing optimal entry points during fast-moving markets
Large number of parameters in the combo strategy makes the optimization process prone to overfitting
Lack of real-time filtering for market volatility and spread may still open positions under unfavorable trading conditions
Multi-confirmation mechanism may frequently produce conflicting signals in ranging markets, leading to indecision
Strategy combo logic lacks adaptive weight adjustment mechanism across changing market regimes
improvements: 增加自适应信号权重机制，根据各信号模块近期表现动态调整其在组合中的权重占比
加入点差过滤和波动率过滤器，避免在高点差或极端波动条件下开仓
引入机器学习模型对信号组合进行动态优化，替代静态参数配置
improvements_en: Add an adaptive signal weighting mechanism that dynamically adjusts each signal module's weight based on its recent performance in the combo
Incorporate spread filtering and volatility filters to prevent opening positions during high-spread or extreme-volatility conditions
Introduce a machine learning model for dynamic optimization of signal combination, replacing static parameter configuration

risk_points: 组合策略的参数优化可能导致过拟合，在实盘环境中表现不及回测
多重确认机制可能在突发事件中反应迟缓，无法及时止损
缺乏对账户整体风险的实时监控，多仓位同时持有时可能超出预期风险敞口
risk_points_en: Parameter optimization of the combo strategy may lead to overfitting, with live performance falling short of backtesting results
Multi-confirmation mechanism may respond sluggishly during sudden market events, unable to cut losses in time
Lack of real-time monitoring of overall account risk means multiple simultaneous positions may exceed expected risk exposure

summary_en: MTC Combo v2 is a multi-strategy Expert Advisor that combines multiple trading techniques (trend following, momentum, and mean reversion signals) across different timeframes to generate composite entry signals. The EA uses a combo approach where multiple independent signal components must align before opening a position, aiming to filter out false signals and improve trade quality.
